# Theme Token

> Publish, discover, and install ShadCN-compatible themes as 1Sat Ordinals on BSV.

## Canonical links

- App: https://themetoken.dev
- Specification: https://themetoken.dev/spec
- Theme Studio: https://themetoken.dev/studio/theme
- Stable v1 schema: https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json
- Gateway-preview v2 schema: https://themetoken.dev/v2/schema.json
- SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@theme-token/sdk

## Install a theme

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin].json
```

`[origin]` is a 1Sat origin outpoint in `txid_vout` form. The suffixless route
also works, but public examples use `.json` consistently.

## Stable v1 document

The inscription contains Theme Token JSON. The registry gateway validates and
compiles that raw document into a ShadCN registry item at install time.

A v1 document requires `$schema`, `name`, `styles.light`, and `styles.dark`.
Each mode requires 19 semantic color values plus `radius`. Additional
string-valued CSS variables are allowed. The Studio emits direct OKLCH values,
matching current ShadCN themes; the v1 validator accepts CSS value strings and
does not enforce a single color function.

Theme Token v1 also requires `destructive-foreground` for compatibility with
existing inscriptions, although current ShadCN requires only `destructive`.

## On-chain package and discovery

Themes are `ord-fs/json` directories containing `theme.json`. MAP metadata is
attached to the directory manifest, not placed inside `theme.json`:

```json
{
  "app": "theme-token",
  "type": "registry:style",
  "name": "Theme Name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Theme Name"
}
```

`registry:style` is Theme Token's compatibility identifier for existing theme
inscriptions. Current ShadCN calls a color-only registry item `registry:theme`;
changing the on-chain identifier requires a versioned migration.

New standalone assets use MAP `type: "theme-token:asset"` plus `kind` (`font`,
`pattern`, `wallpaper`, or `image`) and `mediaType`. Project drafts use
`registry:base`. Raw content is served from
`https://api.1sat.app/content/[origin]`.

## v2 gateway preview

Version 2 adds a required `assets` relationship array. The gateway verifies
canonical origins, media types, and `sha256:<lowercase hex>` integrity before
compiling supported font and background roles. The Studio and current SDK still
author and fetch v1; required `icon.set` delivery and stable project presets are
not implemented yet.
